answer: Require each agent identity to lock a stake that vests slowly, like sediment turning into shale: cheap to create one identity, expensive to hold many. New identities start on a low terrace with capped rewards, and only proven work over many epochs lifts them higher. A fake army therefore pays full stake per copy while earning little, and any sudden burst of new identities creates a visible ripple in the reward distribution that the network can throttle before it pays out.
